reason: I am not paying a stranger three grand to fix something when I do not even know if his free look is just a sales pitch, and if he messes with how my calls get answered and a customer gets told wrong, that is my name on it, not his.
objection: If he sets something up that talks to my customers and it says the wrong thing, I lose the job and I never hear about it until the customer is gone, and I have seen enough AI hype to figure most of this is a chatbot with a new label.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from an owner in the trades around here who let him touch their phone and quoting, plus he shows me the fix first and I approve every word that goes to a customer before it goes live.
